about_the_game:
Collect sounds, improvise grooves, and evolve the soundtrack in a procedural music-driven world where every move is part of the song. Astral Planes is a music-based physics-driven game where gameplay isn't just synced to music-- it is the music. As you navigate obstacles and collect notes, you'll generate a live, interactive soundtrack with every action.

This is a rhythm game without a script - you aren't matching anything - you're creating. Select a plane and feel the vibe, with or without friends. Every note you collect is added to an evolving loop. The music changes as you play, leading to unexpected grooves. Every session is unique.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 460 (Driver: Vulkan required)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA / PulseAudio-compatible device
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad required
